items.raw_excerpt: O número de eleitores quilombolas praticamente dobrou nas eleições de 2026. Jovens de comunidades tradicionais destacam a importância do voto, da participação política e da escolha de representantes comprometidos com a defesa dos territórios e dos direitos quilombolas.

items.raw_excerpt: A century ago politicians in Canberra decided to split the Northern Territory in two and make a remote town the capital of a brand-new jurisdiction called North Australia. A group of history buffs want to ensure this quirky piece of outback history is never forgotten.
items.summary_en: A century ago, politicians in Canberra planned to make Newcastle Waters the capital of a new territory called North Australia. The town never became a capital and slowly turned into a ghost town. Now a group of history buffs are working to preserve this quirky piece of outback history.

items.title_en: Once Australia's northern capital, Newcastle Waters became a ghost town

items.raw_excerpt: Customers who booked "once-in-a-lifetime" holidays to Western Australia's north are left in limbo after a business loan went wrong for a luxury cruise company.
items.summary_en: A luxury cruise company that offered holidays to Western Australia's north has gone into administration after defaulting on a business loan. Passengers who paid for once-in-a-lifetime trips are left out of pocket with no ship to sail on. The company's vessel has been seized by receivers.

items.summary_en: Aseta Redican became the first Pacific person to qualify as a physiotherapist in New Zealand in 1964. She graduated from Otago's School of Physiotherapy. She has now been awarded an honorary doctorate for her pioneering achievement.

items.raw_excerpt: Sugarcane farmers have two years to stop using controversial herbicide paraquat, despite the chemical regulator allowing its use on most boardacre crops.
items.summary_en: Australian sugarcane farmers have two years to stop using the herbicide paraquat. The chemical regulator APVMA allows paraquat on most crops but is phasing it out. Farmers say the ban will raise costs and hurt their livelihoods.

items.summary_en: Gippsland Youth Spaces has been helping vulnerable young people for years with safety and support. Now dwindling funding could force the service to shut down. The closure would leave at-risk youth without a vital local resource.

items.raw_excerpt: From TV shows to pop music and manga, menopause is increasingly being portrayed honestly rather than for laughs. Experts say this shift is helping midlife women feel seen and society better understand this life stage.
items.summary_en: Menopause is increasingly portrayed honestly in TV shows, pop music, and manga instead of being used as a joke. Experts say this shift helps midlife women feel seen and helps society better understand this life stage.

items.summary_en: The Adelaide City Council is considering dropping the speed limit to 40 km/h on O'Connell Street in North Adelaide. The change would affect commuters passing through one of the area's main thoroughfares. The street is a busy retail strip popular with locals and visitors.

items.raw_excerpt: Telangana auto drivers end strike after government promises a welfare board and fare hike, ensuring worker benefits and support.
items.summary_en: Auto, cab and school van drivers in Telangana called off an indefinite strike after meeting with the Transport Minister. The government promised to create a welfare board for auto workers and agreed to raise fares for the first time since 2012. It also announced subsidies for converting old autos to electric.

items.title_en: Telangana Auto Drivers End Strike After Government Promises Welfare Board
